captions.instagram:
Class 11 Chemistry · States of Matter (Gas Laws)
Chemistry, visualised #3 · Add gas: why does the volume grow? 🎈

A gas under a free lid, same temperature, same pressure. Add gas: 12 → 24 → 48 particles. The lid rises: 1 → 2 → 4 L.
Why? Each particle has the same speed, so twice the particles in twice the room hit the lid just as often. Watch the counter: about 12 hits a second the whole time. Same hits, same pressure.

That's Avogadro's law: V ∝ n. Equal volumes of gases (same T and P) hold equal numbers of particles.
